summary:
Iter 74 — Phase 3 Vendor Bill Processing, Payables, GST Input, TDS Payable & Payment Control verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 23/23 PASS (catalog + bill CRUD/totals/verify+approve+JE + duplicate/missing-PO-GRN/TDS-cap/PO-GRN-mismatch validations + vendor-payment+JE + bank-verified gate + excess-payment rule + 13 payable reports). Frontend Playwright: Login + /app/accounts loads, all 8 new Payables sidebar items render (acc-nav-vendor_bills/vendor_pays/vendor_outs/payment_due/tds_payable/retn_payable/gst_purchase/grn_pending), New Vendor Bill dialog opens with the complete field set + real-time Totals panel (Taxable / GST(18%) / Gross / TDS / Net Payable) and a 'Bank details NOT verified — payment will be blocked' inline warning when checkbox is off. Dashboard wires live aggregates: Vendor Payable ₹4,440, TDS Payable ₹1,000, Retention Payable ₹2,000.

BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_iter74_payables_phase3.py — 23/23 PASS):
  · GET /api/payables/expense-categories → 18 categories, material→5105 verified.
  · POST /api/payables/vendor-bills (Pipes 100Mtr@250, GST 18, TDS 194C@2, force_no_po+force_no_grn, bank_verified=true) → bill_no matches ^VB-2026-\d{4}$, totals exact: taxable=25000, gst=4500, cgst=2250, sgst=2250, gross=29500, tds=500, net_payable=29000, outstanding=29000, status='draft'.
  · Duplicate invoice (same vendor + invoice_no) → 409 'Duplicate invoice ... already exists'.
  · Missing PO+GRN (no force, no service_conf) → 400 'PO number required'.
  · TDS rate=200 → 400 'TDS amount cannot exceed gross invoice value'.
  · POST .../verify → status='verified'. POST .../approve → status='approved', je_voucher_number set. JE fetched via /api/accounts/journal-entries: voucher_type='PUV', balanced D=C=29500, DR 5105=25000 + DR 1700=4500 / CR 2100=29000 + CR 2400=500 (line-level mapping exact).
  · Re-approve → 400 'Cannot approve bill in status approved'.
  · POST /api/payables/vendor-payments (NEFT, UTR, amount=28000, retention_held=1000) → total_settled=29000, status='released', JE PV balanced D=C=29000: DR 2100=29000 / CR 1100=28000 + CR 2110=1000. Bill becomes status='paid', outstanding=0.
  · Bank-not-verified bill payment → 400 'Vendor bank details NOT verified ... cannot pay'.
  · Excess payment without reason → 400 'Excess payment ... requires excess_reason'. With reason → 200.
  · PO/GRN mismatch (existing GRN-2026-0006 belongs to PO-2026-0043, supplied FAKE-PO-XYZ-9999) → 400 'GRN GRN-2026-0006 belongs to PO PO-2026-0043, not FAKE-PO-XYZ-9999'.
  · 13 reports verified: vendor-outstanding (buckets 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ + total + vendors), payable-aging (alias OK), payment-due?days_ahead=7 (rows + total_due), vendor-advance (reads 1510 from journal_entries), retention-payable (total_retention ≥ 1000 confirmed), tds-payable (total_tds ≥ 500, by_section includes 194C), gst-purchase-register (rows + totals; sum(rows.gross) == totals.gross), project-vendor-cost, grn-pending-invoice (real GRNs from db.grn), duplicate-invoice-check (empty), vendor-ledger?vendor_name=... (date-sorted events with running balance), po-payable.

REGRESSION: /app/backend/tests/test_iter72_accounts_phase1.py (12/12) + test_iter73_billing_phase2.py (21/21) → 33/33 PASS — Phase 1+2 untouched.

FRONTEND (admin@erp.com / Admin@123):
  · /app/accounts loads with new 'Payables' group in sidebar with 8 items, all data-testid wired.
  · acc-nav-vendor_bills view loads with existing bill rows (real data from preview DB).
  · pay-vb-add → 'New Vendor Bill' dialog renders the FULL spec: Vendor*, GSTIN, PAN, MSME dropdown, Bank Verified checkbox, Vendor Inv #*, Invoice Date*, Received Date, PO #, GRN #, Service Conf #, Project Code, Expense Category, Force-Override (No PO + No GRN), Priority, Due Days, Lines table (Description/Qty/Unit/Rate/Amount with + Line button), GST %, Tax Type (Intra-state/Inter-state), TDS Section, TDS %, Advance Adjusted, Retention Withheld, and the Totals panel: Taxable / GST(18%) / Gross / TDS / Net Payable in real time.
  · Bank-verified-off shows red inline message 'Bank details NOT verified — payment will be blocked until verified.' — wired correctly to the same flag the backend validator reads.
  · Accounts dashboard wires LIVE aggregates from the new collections — Vendor Payable ₹4,440 / Retention Payable ₹2,000 / TDS Payable ₹1,000 / Total Payables ₹70,000.

issues: Line-row Description input has no data-testid (e.g. pay-vb-line-0-desc) — same for Qty / Rate / Amount cells. This forced the Playwright filling step to rely on placeholder/index selectors, which is less robust. Suggestion: add testids pay-vb-line-{i}-{desc|qty|rate|amount} to harden automated regression.

action_items: (Optional UX hardening) Add data-testid attributes to the Line items table (pay-vb-line-{i}-desc / qty / rate / amount) inside VendorBillingViews.jsx → makes the UI safer to assert in automated runs.
critical_code_review_comments: vendor_billing_router.py (~716 lines) is well-organized: EXPENSE_CATEGORY_MAP (18 keys) → account codes, Pydantic schemas (VendorBillIn / VendorPaymentIn) with optional FK ids, totals helper, _validate_bill_dependencies covers dup-invoice / PO match / GRN match / PO-GRN cross-check / force overrides — all checks raise 400/409 cleanly.
_compute_bill_totals correctly handles intra-state CGST/SGST split vs IGST, advance & retention deducts in net_payable, rounds to 2dp — all 23 backend tests validate this.

approve_vendor_bill posts JE via accounting_service.post_vendor_invoice_verify with full leg-set (Expense + GST Input 1700 / AP 2100 + TDS Payable 2400 + Vendor Advance 1510 + Retention Payable 2110). JE is balanced D=C and lines map exactly as spec — verified line-by-line.
Approve also bumps projects.cost_incurred via $inc — clean side-effect, matches Phase-2 receivables which bumps revenue_invoiced.

create_vendor_payment: bank_verified gate runs on EVERY bill in payload (not just first); FIFO apply across multiple bills; tracks paid_amount via $inc and recomputes outstanding; flips status to partially_paid → paid based on remaining; excess_reason required when total_settled > Σ outstanding by 0.01. All correct.
Payment JE legs: DR 2100 (AP) + CR 1100/Cash + CR 2110 (Retention Payable) + CR 5900 (Other Deduction) — voucher_type='PV', balanced — verified.

All 13 reports exclude _id (no Mongo leaks), aggregate server-side, sort sensibly. Aging buckets {0-30,31-60,61-90,90+} are computed from invoice_date (date today − invoice_date) — correct convention for AP.
vendor-ledger sorts events chronologically with running debit-credit balance — matches the receivables ledger pattern from Phase 2 — clean parity.
payable-aging is a thin alias of vendor-outstanding — keeps API surface consistent with naming both ways.

Minor: vendor_advance_report reads only journal_entries on account 1510 — assumes Phase-1 vendor advance flow always posts to 1510. If a different code is ever used for advances, this report will undercount — but spec is consistent.
Minor: cancel_vendor_bill correctly forbids cancelling approved bills (must go via DN/CN) — financial integrity preserved.

Minor: in /reports/duplicate-invoice-check the aggregation groups by (vendor_id, vendor_name, invoice_no) — a bill missing vendor_id would not collide with the same vendor by name+invoice_no — but enforcement at create time uses an OR'd vendor_id-or-name check, so this is acceptable in practice.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 — bills + payments + 13 reports + all 5 validation gates)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 nav items render, dialog renders complete spec field set, dashboard aggregates wired.

seed_data_creation: Iter 74 run created (TS-suffixed) on preview DB: ~4 vendor_bills (ZQ Test Steel TS — paid; ZQ_NoBank_TS — approved unpaid for the bank-gate test; ZQ_Excess_TS — paid+excess advance; ZQ_Mis_TS — rejected at create). 2 vendor_payments. 2 journal_entries (PUV + PV) — all balanced. As suggested by main agent, future cleanup can delete TEST/ZQ_*_<TS> rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 backend is rock-solid. Re-running test_iter74_payables_phase3.py with a fresh timestamp is safe (no duplicate conflicts). The PO/GRN-mismatch test hard-codes GRN-2026-0006 / PO-2026-0043 — if preview DB is reset, regenerate by querying db.grn for any {grn_number,po_number} pair. accounting_service.post_vendor_invoice_verify and post_vendor_payment hooks remain backward-compatible with Phase-1 callers (iter72 still 12/12 PASS).
rca of the issue: No defects found. Sole minor finding is UX hardening (testids on Line table rows) — not a functional bug.
